family_decision: How much more did the same Sanctuary public All Inclusive plan cost than Room Only, and what does that difference not establish?
hypothesis: Two adjacent prices without plan names or a computed increment force avoidable subtraction and can be mistaken for a hotel range or full meal budget.
baseline: Overview showed anonymous USD876.40 /1176.20 with a Room Only/All Inclusive note; detail plans and terms existed but no same-room increment. Source prices are dated October9, not rechecked in this task.
result: IMPLEMENT public plan identity and integer-cent subtraction: USD1499.00 per sampled five-night stay, USD299.80 per configuration/night. Not per-person, savings, meal entitlement, seasonal range or final fee-inclusive cost.
preserve: Tax not included; rounded whole-dollar booking cards
Unknown mandatory fees, bedding, incidentals and exact meals/outlets
Two-under12 promotion does not cover all three children; age12 not under12
October28at23:59 card versus ten-day terms remains a cancellation conflict
35percent deposit is payment timing, not an extra charge; exact deposit base/hold unknown
No source or price renewal; two unpriced categories remain priority research gaps
confidence: High dated arithmetic and proxy scan gap; actual users, current inventory, full costs and value unknown
lesson: Compare like-for-like public plans using stay totals before nightly rounding; do not convert a meal-plan increment into meal savings or entitlements.
